hints.title: Directional State Passing
hints.text: Traverse the tree passing down the direction of the previous step and the current path length.

hints.title: Switching vs Restarting
hints.text: Moving in the opposite direction increments the current length by 1. Moving in the same direction resets the length to 1.

hints.title: Global Maximum Tracking
hints.text: Maintain a global maximum across all traversed path lengths and return it after inspecting the entire tree.

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing zigzag path lengths from scratch at each node leads to quadratic O(N^2) complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single traversal maintaining alternating lengths visits each node once in O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles the two branching choices: continue zigzagging or restart a fresh length 1 path.
complexity.notes: Path length counts edges, not nodes.
